brief:
Hamas expressed its condolences to Egypt and Jordan following a passenger bus accident in South Sinai, the Shehab Wire reported. The Islamic Resistance Movement said it was extending its sympathy to both nations in the wake of the traffic incident, which resulted in casualties when a bus carrying passengers overturned in the South Sinai governorate.

The statement from Hamas did not specify the number of people killed or injured in the crash. Details about the cause of the accident or the circumstances surrounding the bus's overturn were not immediately available.
